name: Glass Chess Required Update
notes: Adds Quick Match matchmaking with automatic opponent pairing and cancellation
Adds shareable private friend invitations with eight-character codes and fifteen-minute expiry
Prevents duplicate queue entries and blocks a player from joining multiple active rooms
Keeps move legality and board state authoritative on the online server, with expected-ply checks
Broadcasts server-derived move notation and capture, check, checkmate, and castling effects
Connects online play to the hosted Glass Chess multiplayer server
